entities.name: Istanbul Railway Museum
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Istanbul Railway Museum is a railway museum in the historic Istanbul Sirkeci Terminal in the Sirkeci neighborhood of Fatih district in Istanbul, Turkey. Opened on September 23, 2005, the museum is owned and operated by the Turkish State Railways (TCDD).
